en-US.extra-build-layers.machine-level.title: Machine Level <level/>

Build on <gl>further layers</gl> inside every platform, up to level <to/>.

en-US.extra-build-layers.space-level.title: Space Level <level/>

en-US.extra-build-layers.lift-station.belt-ent: The bottom of a tall <gl>space belt</gl> climb. Drag a space belt up or down several space levels and an entry and exit are placed for you.
en-US.extra-build-layers.lift-station.belt-exi: The top of a tall <gl>space belt</gl> climb. Drag a space belt up or down several space levels and an entry and exit are placed for you.
en-US.extra-build-layers.lift-station.pipe-ent: The bottom of a tall <gl>space pipe</gl> climb. Drag a space pipe up or down several space levels and an entry and exit are placed for you.
en-US.extra-build-layers.lift-station.pipe-exi: The top of a tall <gl>space pipe</gl> climb. Drag a space pipe up or down several space levels and an entry and exit are placed for you.
en-US.extra-build-layers.view-selection.title: View
en-US.extra-build-layers.view-selection.descri: Move the camera to the selection, on its layer.
